rules.name: CreatePolicyVersion
rules.title: CreatePolicyVersion: can rewrite a customer-managed policy attached to a principal
rules.description: Can create a new default version of a customer-managed policy with arbitrary permissions
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:CreatePolicyVersion to specific policy ARNs or remove

rules.name: SetDefaultPolicyVersion
rules.title: SetDefaultPolicyVersion: can activate a more permissive older version of a customer-managed policy
rules.description: Can activate older permissive policy versions
rules.remediation: Remove iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion or restrict to specific policies; delete unused permissive policy versions

rules.name: PutUserPolicy
rules.title: PutUserPolicy: can write an inline policy on a user
rules.description: Can create arbitrary inline policy on users
rules.remediation: Remove iam:PutUserPolicy or restrict Resource to specific user ARNs

rules.name: PutGroupPolicy
rules.title: PutGroupPolicy: can write an inline policy on a group
rules.description: Can create arbitrary inline policy on groups
rules.remediation: Remove iam:PutGroupPolicy or restrict Resource to specific group ARNs

rules.name: PutRolePolicy
rules.title: PutRolePolicy: can write an inline policy on a role
rules.description: Can create arbitrary inline policy on roles
rules.remediation: Remove iam:PutRolePolicy or restrict Resource to specific role ARNs

rules.name: AttachUserPolicy
rules.title: AttachUserPolicy: can attach managed policies (including AdministratorAccess) to a user
rules.description: Can attach managed policies (including AdministratorAccess) to users
rules.remediation: Remove or restrict iam:AttachUserPolicy

rules.name: AttachGroupPolicy
rules.title: AttachGroupPolicy: can attach managed policies (including AdministratorAccess) to a group
rules.description: Can attach managed policies (including AdministratorAccess) to groups
rules.remediation: Remove or restrict iam:AttachGroupPolicy

rules.name: AttachRolePolicy
rules.title: AttachRolePolicy: can attach managed policies (including AdministratorAccess) to a role
rules.description: Can attach managed policies (including AdministratorAccess) to roles
rules.remediation: Remove or restrict iam:AttachRolePolicy

rules.name: CreateAccessKey
rules.title: CreateAccessKey: can create access keys for other users
rules.description: Can create access keys for other users
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:CreateAccessKey Resource to self only (${aws:username})

rules.name: CreateLoginProfile
rules.title: CreateLoginProfile: can create a console password for another user
rules.description: Can create console login for users without one
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:CreateLoginProfile Resource to self only

rules.name: UpdateLoginProfile
rules.title: UpdateLoginProfile: can reset the console password of another user
rules.description: Can reset console passwords for other users
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:UpdateLoginProfile Resource to self only

rules.name: AddUserToGroup
rules.title: AddUserToGroup: can add a user to a more privileged group
rules.description: Can add self or others to privileged groups
rules.remediation: Remove or restrict iam:AddUserToGroup to specific groups

rules.name: UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
rules.title: UpdateAssumeRolePolicy: can rewrite a role's trust policy and assume it
rules.description: Can modify role trust policies to allow self to assume any role
rules.remediation: Remove iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy or restrict to specific role ARNs

rules.name: PassRole+Lambda
rules.title: PassRole+Lambda: can run code as a passed role in a new Lambda function
rules.description: Can pass privileged role to Lambda and execute arbitrary code
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole Resource to specific role ARNs and add an iam:PassedToService condition

rules.name: PassRole+EC2
rules.title: PassRole+EC2: can launch an instance with a passed role and read its credentials
rules.description: Can launch EC2 with privileged role, access credentials via IMDS
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole Resource to specific role ARNs

rules.name: PassRole+CloudFormation
rules.title: PassRole+CloudFormation: can create a stack that runs as a passed role
rules.description: Can create CloudFormation stack with privileged role
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole and cloudformation:CreateStack

rules.name: PassRole+ECS
rules.title: PassRole+ECS: can run a task as a passed role
rules.description: Can run ECS task with privileged role
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole Resource to specific role ARNs

rules.name: PassRole+Glue
rules.title: PassRole+Glue: can run a dev endpoint or job as a passed role
rules.description: Can create Glue endpoint/job with privileged role
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole Resource to specific role ARNs

rules.name: PassRole+CodeBuild
rules.title: PassRole+CodeBuild: can create and start a build project that runs as a passed role
rules.description: Can create CodeBuild project with privileged role
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole Resource to specific role ARNs

rules.name: PassRole+SageMaker
rules.title: PassRole+SageMaker: can open a notebook instance that runs as a passed role
rules.description: Can create SageMaker notebook with privileged role
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole Resource to specific role ARNs

rules.name: UpdateFunctionCode
rules.title: UpdateFunctionCode: can replace the code of an existing function and run as its role
rules.description: Can replace the code of an existing Lambda function; the code runs as the function's execution role
rules.remediation: Restrict lambda:UpdateFunctionCode to specific functions whose roles are not more privileged

rules.name: UpdateDevEndpoint
rules.title: UpdateDevEndpoint: can add an SSH key to an existing Glue dev endpoint and run as its role
rules.description: Can update an existing Glue development endpoint (SSH public key) and run code as its role
rules.remediation: Restrict glue:UpdateDevEndpoint to specific endpoints

rules.name: StartBuild (buildspec override)
rules.title: StartBuild: can start an existing CodeBuild project with an overridden buildspec and run as its role
rules.description: Can start an existing CodeBuild project with a buildspec override; the build runs as the project's service role
rules.remediation: Restrict codebuild:StartBuild to specific projects and their service roles

rules.name: CreateAccessKey+DeleteAccessKey
rules.title: CreateAccessKey+DeleteAccessKey: can replace an access key of a user that already has two
rules.description: Can delete one of another user's two access keys and create a new one for that user
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:CreateAccessKey and iam:DeleteAccessKey to the caller's own user (user/${aws:username})

rules.name: PassRole+Lambda via AddPermission

rules.description: Can pass a privileged role to a new Lambda function it can invoke through the function policy and run arbitrary code or API calls as that role
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole Resource to specific role ARNs, add an iam:PassedToService condition and limit who can create a new Lambda function it can invoke through the function policy

rules.remediation: Restrict ssm:StartSession / ssm:SendCommand / ec2-instance-connect:SendSSHPublicKey to specific instances (tags or ARNs) and keep privileged instance profiles off shared instances

rules.name: Instance user-data rewrite
rules.title: Instance user-data rewrite: can run code as the role of an existing EC2 instance with an instance profile
rules.description: Can take over an existing EC2 instance with an instance profile and run code or API calls as the role it runs as
rules.remediation: Restrict ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute together with Stop/StartInstances on instances with privileged roles

rules.name: Launch template version
rules.title: Launch template version: can run code as the role of an existing EC2 launch template with an instance profile
rules.description: Can take over an existing EC2 launch template with an instance profile and run code or API calls as the role it runs as
rules.remediation: Restrict ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion / ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate on templates that carry privileged instance profiles

rules.name: ECS Exec
rules.title: ECS Exec: can run code as the role of an existing ECS service with ECS Exec enabled
rules.description: Can take over an existing ECS service with ECS Exec enabled and run code or API calls as the role it runs as
rules.remediation: Restrict ecs:ExecuteCommand to specific clusters and tasks, and enable ECS Exec only where needed

rules.name: SageMaker presigned notebook URL
rules.title: SageMaker presigned notebook URL: can run code as the role of an existing SageMaker notebook instance
rules.description: Can take over an existing SageMaker notebook instance and run code or API calls as the role it runs as
rules.remediation: Restrict sagemaker:CreatePresignedNotebookInstanceUrl to the notebook's owners

rules.name: SageMaker notebook lifecycle configuration
rules.title: SageMaker notebook lifecycle configuration: can run code as the role of an existing SageMaker notebook instance
rules.description: Can take over an existing SageMaker notebook instance and run code or API calls as the role it runs as
rules.remediation: Restrict lifecycle-configuration changes and notebook updates on notebooks with privileged roles

rules.name: SageMaker Studio presigned domain URL
rules.title: SageMaker Studio presigned domain URL: can run code as the role of an existing SageMaker Studio user profile
rules.description: Can take over an existing SageMaker Studio user profile and run code or API calls as the role it runs as
rules.remediation: Restrict sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl to each user's own profile (sagemaker:ResourceTag or profile ARN)

rules.name: App Runner service update
rules.title: App Runner service update: can run code as the role of an existing App Runner service
rules.description: Can take over an existing App Runner service and run code or API calls as the role it runs as (this resource type is not collected: whether one runs as a privileged role is unknown)
rules.remediation: Restrict the App Runner service actions to the resources each principal owns; aws-enumerator does not collect App Runner services, so review which roles they run as

rules.name: PassRole+instance profile association

rules.description: Can associate a privileged role's instance profile with an existing instance and run commands there (Systems Manager or EC2 Instance Connect), then use the role's credentials from the instance metadata service
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole to specific roles with iam:PassedToService ec2.amazonaws.com, and restrict ec2:AssociateIamInstanceProfile / ReplaceIamInstanceProfileAssociation

rules.name: PassRole+Auto Scaling

rules.description: Can create a launch configuration or launch template with a privileged instance profile and user data, and an Auto Scaling group that launches it
rules.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole to specific roles with iam:PassedToService ec2.amazonaws.com, and restrict who can create launch configurations, launch templates and Auto Scaling groups

rules.name: User permissions boundary removal
rules.title: User permissions boundary removal: can delete or replace the permissions boundary of a user
rules.description: Can delete or replace the permissions boundary of a user that has one, lifting the cap on its identity policies
rules.remediation: Deny iam:DeleteUserPermissionsBoundary and iam:PutUserPermissionsBoundary to the principals the boundary is meant to cap (a boundary-protection statement in the boundary itself)

rules.name: Role permissions boundary removal
rules.title: Role permissions boundary removal: can delete or replace the permissions boundary of a role
rules.description: Can delete or replace the permissions boundary of a role that has one, lifting the cap on its identity policies
rules.remediation: Deny iam:DeleteRolePermissionsBoundary and iam:PutRolePermissionsBoundary to the principals the boundary is meant to cap (a boundary-protection statement in the boundary itself)
